features.name: price_differential
features.description: Normalized difference between NSW and VIC electricity prices, capturing inter-regional price spread
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear separator for price divergence patterns that correlate with electricity flow direction

features.name: demand_imbalance
features.description: Normalized difference between NSW and VIC demand levels, indicating regional consumption asymmetry
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous measure of demand imbalance useful for linear margin separation

features.name: nsw_price_to_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of NSW price to NSW demand, approximating price elasticity signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures price-demand relationship as a single continuous feature for linear models

features.name: vic_price_to_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of VIC price to VIC demand, approximating VIC price elasticity signal
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures VIC price-demand relationship as a continuous feature complementing NSW ratio

features.name: transfer_demand_ratio
features.description: Ratio of inter-regional transfer to total demand, indicating transfer intensity relative to consumption
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized transfer feature that scales with demand context, useful for linear decision boundaries

features.name: log_nsw_price
features.description: Log-transformed NSW price to reduce skewness and improve linear separability
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation compresses price distribution for better linear SVM margin utilization

features.name: log_vic_price
features.description: Log-transformed VIC price to reduce skewness and improve linear separability
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation of VIC price reduces extreme value influence on SVM margins

features.name: time_of_day_score
features.description: Composite time score combining date progression and intra-day period as a weighted linear combination
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth temporal feature capturing both seasonal and intra-day patterns for linear models

features.name: total_demand_score
features.description: Weighted sum of NSW and VIC demand as a composite demand pressure indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Single continuous demand feature capturing overall grid load for linear separation

features.name: price_demand_composite
features.description: Weighted composite of price and demand signals across both regions as a market stress indicator
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregated market signal combining price and demand into a single linear projection feature

features.name: transfer_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Deviation of transfer from its training mean (0.499), normalized by training std (0.152), clipped to z-score range
features.expected_model_benefit: Standardized transfer deviation provides a zero-centered continuous feature ideal for SVM margins

features.name: market_stress_severity
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall market stress level based on combined price spikes, demand peaks, and transfer extremes. High values indicate stressed market conditions with elevated prices and demand simultaneously.
features.expected_model_benefit: Holistic market stress score that captures non-linear interactions between price, demand, and transfer as a smooth severity measure for linear SVM
